Every hop is SSRF-checked before it is requested. A blocked hop is reported in
``blocked_hop`` with a ``200`` — it is a finding, not a client error (API_ENDPOINTS §6).

post.description: Returns DNS-TXT and HTTPS-file challenges. The raw token appears only in this response. Calling again for the same domain issues a fresh challenge and invalidates the old one (this is also how a verified domain is re-verified). Responses are deliberately not stored for Idempotency-Key replay, because they contain the token.
